budget_basis: uniform rank 32 on every layer of the SmolLM2 block set, priced by factored.storage_bytes
prompt:
You are proposing compression recipes for a factored 1-bit weight-delta format. A recipe assigns an integer rank to each layer of one transformer block set. The stored size of one layer at rank r is priced exactly as:

  bytes(layer, r) = ceil(rows * r / 8) + 4 * rows + 2 * cols * r

Layers (rows x cols of the delta matrix):
  embed: delta matrix 49152 x 960, rank may be 0..960
  attn.q_proj: delta matrix 960 x 960, rank may be 0..960
  attn.k_proj: delta matrix 320 x 960, rank may be 0..320
  attn.v_proj: delta matrix 320 x 960, rank may be 0..320
  attn.o_proj: delta matrix 960 x 960, rank may be 0..960
  mlp.gate: delta matrix 2560 x 960, rank may be 0..960
  mlp.up: delta matrix 2560 x 960, rank may be 0..960
  mlp.down: delta matrix 960 x 2560, rank may be 0..960

The total size of a recipe is the sum of bytes(layer, rank) over all layers and must be <= 1056256 bytes (that is the cost of the uniform rank-32 recipe; you have the same bytes, spend them differently).

Propose exactly 5 recipes. Make them genuinely different from each other and from the uniform recipe: uneven allocations are the point. Ideas you may use or ignore: starve some layers to rank 0 and feed others, front-load early layers, front-load the MLP, protect attention output, protect the embedding. Every recipe must include every layer name exactly once in its "ranks" object, with an integer rank (0 is allowed and means the layer's delta is dropped).

Reply with ONLY a JSON object, no markdown fences, no commentary, in exactly this shape:
{"recipes": [{"name": "<short name>", "reason": "<one sentence>", "ranks": {"embed": 0, "attn.q_proj": 0, "attn.k_proj": 0, "attn.v_proj": 0, "attn.o_proj": 0, "mlp.gate": 0, "mlp.up": 0, "mlp.down": 0}}]}
Replace the zeros with your ranks. Check your arithmetic: each recipe's total must be <= 1056256 bytes.
